sloka: एते महाबला वीरा राक्षसा युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः।जेतारः परसैन्यानां परैर्नित्यापराजिताः ।। ६.७२.३ ।।
transliteration: ete mahābalā vīrā rākṣasā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ।jetāraḥ parasainyānāṁ parairnityāparājitāḥ ।। 6.72.3 ।।

translations.english: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."
translations.hindi: उसने कुछ देर तक ते वानरी सेना को अपने पराक्रम से दंग कर दिआ था । अन्त में बह श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के हाथ से मारा गया । उसका आधा शरीर भयङ्कर समुद्र में जा गिरा
